options: As if
Because
Unless
Although
Since
questions.question:
다음 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?
__________ everyone played well, we lost the game.
questions.explanation: 우리가 경기에 졌다는 사실과 모두가 잘 했다는 내용이 대조되므로 양보의 의미 'Although(비록~이지만)'가 적절합니다.

options: As if
Because
Although
When
Since
questions.question:
다음 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?
__________ the wind was blowing, it wasn't very cold.
questions.explanation: 바람이 불고 있다는 사실과 추위가 심하지 않다는 내용이 대조되므로 양보의 의미 'Although(비록~이지만)'가 적절합니다.

options: Even
Although
Before
With
But
questions.question:
다음 두 문장의 의미가 같도록 빈 곳에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?
We can't be together, but I always love you.
= __________ we can't be together, I always love you.
questions.explanation: 'but'의 의미(대조)를 나타내려면 양보절 'Although(비록~이지만)'로 표현해야 합니다.

options: despite
unless
since
because
although
questions.question:
다음 대화의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?
A: Did you go to bed early last night?
B: I stayed up late __________ I was very exhausted.
questions.explanation: 늦게 깨어 있었다는 것과 피곤했다는 내용이 인과관계이므로 'because(왜냐하면)'가 적절합니다.

options: because
unless
although
that
since
questions.question:
다음 대화의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?
A: What did Rachel do last weekend?
B: She went hiking __________ it was snowy and chilly.
questions.explanation: 눈이 오고 쌀쌀함에도 불구하고 하이킹을 갔다는 대조 관계이므로 'although(비록~이지만)'가 적절합니다.

options: he couldn't have breakfast
he didn't do his homework
he didn't take his lunchbox
he wasn't late for the class
he missed the bus
questions.question:
다음 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?
Though he got up late, __________.
questions.explanation: 'Though he got up late(늦게 일어났음에도 불구하고)'라는 양보절에 대조되는 결과는 '수업에 늦지 않았다'가 적절합니다.

options: we arrived on time
I got there on time
we didn't miss the class
we weren't late for school
I was too late to be on time
questions.question:
다음 대화의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 적절하지 않은 것은?
A: Was the traffic heavy?
B: Yes, it was. Although the traffic was heavy, __________.
questions.explanation: 교통이 막혔음에도 불구하고라는 양보 관계에 '너무 늦어서 제 시간에 도착하지 못했다'는 모순되므로 적절하지 않습니다.

options: I didn't pass the exam
they had no trouble getting there
I failed the exam
I passed the exam
they couldn't arrive on time
questions.question:
다음 문장이 자연스러운 의미가 되도록 빈 칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은? (정답 2개)
• Though the students didn't have a map, __________.
• Though I made a mistake, __________.
questions.explanation: (지도가 없었지만 잘 찾아갔다 / 실수를 했지만 시험에 합격했다)

options: (A) while / (B) For
(A) while / (B) Although
(A) although / (B) To
(A) although / (B) In spite of
(A) although / (B) For
questions.question:
다음 글의 빈칸 (A), (B)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?
• He refused to attend the seminar (A)__________ they asked him to do many times.
• (B)__________ being late for school, she could take the exam.
questions.explanation: (A)는 '많이 요청했음에도 불구하고'라는 양보 의미의 'although'가 적절하고, (B)는 '수업에 늦은 것에도 불구하고'라는 양보 의미의 'In spite of'가 적절합니다.

options: (A) so / (B) Although
(A) since / (B) Before
(A) because / (B) Though
(A) that / (B) As
(A) whether / (B) If
questions.question:
다음 글의 빈칸 (A), (B)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?
• They were very happy (A)__________ they won the game.
• (B)__________ the sun was shining, it wasn't very warm.
questions.explanation: (A)는 '경기를 이겼기 때문에 행복했다'는 인과 관계의 'because'가 적절하고, (B)는 '태양이 비치고 있음에도 불구하고 따뜻하지 않다'는 양보 의미의 'Though'가 적절합니다.

options: (A) despite / (B) While
(A) although / (B) But
(A) although / (B) Though
(A) although / (B) in spite of
(A) despite / (B) Though
questions.question:
다음 빈칸 (A), (B)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?
• Her voice was shaking (A)__________ all her efforts to control it.
• (B)__________ Betty left me 20 years ago, I still miss her.
questions.explanation: (A는 이겼기 때문에 <이유>, B는 해가 빛났지만 따뜻하지 않았다 <양보>)

options: (A) Since / (B) While / (C) As
(A) Although / (B) But / (C) Because
(A) Though / (B) Though / (C) Although
(A) As / (B) But / (C) But
(A) Since / (B) Though / (C) Even though
questions.question:
다음 글의 빈칸 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?
• (A)__________ the weather is so bad, I'm not going out today.
• (B)__________ Betty left me 20 years ago, I still miss her.
• (C)__________ it was raining, we continued playing soccer.
questions.explanation: A는 날씨가 나쁘기 때문에 <이유: Since>, B와 C는 반대 내용 <양보: Though / Even though>

options: once
since
although
because
however
questions.question:
다음 문장의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 적절하지 않은 것은? (대소문자 관계없음)
• I got up late __________ I had a bad cold.
• __________ I was late, I went to the meeting.
• I have studied English __________ I was five years old.
• __________ the food gets into the rivers, the water quickly becomes dirty.
• I don't like hamburgers __________ they're bad for my health.
questions.explanation: 'however'는 부사이며 다른 보기들은 접속사이므로, 문맥에 맞는 접속사만 가능합니다. 특히 마지막 문장에서 'they're bad for my health'라는 이유를 나타내므로 'because'가 필요하고, 'however'는 문법적으로 맞지 않습니다.

options: (A) Although / (B) although
(A) As long as / (B) although
(A) Because / (B) as long as
(A) Although / (B) because
(A) So / (B) as long as
questions.question:
다음 글의 빈칸 (A), (B)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?
• At first, you thought that it would be very warm because the sun was shining, but when you later went outside, it wasn't very warm.
→ (A)__________ the sun was shining, it wasn't very warm.
• What he felt towards her was love. He never called it 'love,' but that didn't change the fact that he loved her.
→ He was in love with her (B)__________ he did not put that name to his feeling.
questions.explanation: (A)는 '태양이 비치고 있음에도 불구하고 따뜻하지 않다'는 대조의 'Although'가 적절하고, (B)는 '그 감정에 이름을 붙이지 않았음에도 불구하고 사랑했다'는 대조의 'although'가 적절합니다.

options: Because the weather was bad, many people came to see the concert.
Though the weather was bad, many people came to see the concert.
While the weather was bad, many people came to see the concert.
Thanks to the bad weather, many people came to see the concert.
Due to the bad weather, many people came to see the concert.
questions.question:
다음 우리말을 바르게 영작한 것은?
날씨는 나빴지만, 많은 사람들이 콘서트를 보기 위해 왔다.
questions.explanation: '날씨는 나빴지만'은 양보의 의미이므로 'Though(비록~이지만)'가 가장 적절합니다.

options: Since I didn't win the contest, I was proud of myself.
I didn't win the contest since I was proud of myself.
Though I didn't win the contest, I was proud of myself.
I didn't win the contest although I was proud of myself.
Until I didn't win the contest, I was proud of myself.
questions.question:
다음 우리말을 바르게 영작한 것은?
비록 대회에서 이기지 못했지만, 나는 내가 자랑스럽다.
questions.explanation: '비록~이지만'은 양보의 의미이므로 'Though'를 사용하여 'Though I didn't win the contest, I was proud of myself.'가 정답입니다.

options: Since she felt like crying, she was smiling.
She felt like crying, but she was smiling.
Even though she felt like crying, she was smiling.
Because she felt like crying, she was smiling.
She felt like crying although she was smiling.
questions.question:
다음 우리말을 바르게 영작한 것은?(정답 2개)
울고 싶지만, 그녀는 미소를 짓고 있었다.
questions.explanation: 울고 싶었지만(but) 미소 지었다 / 울고 싶었음에도 불구하고(Even though) 미소 지었다

options: He was very sick, so he went to work.
He was very sick, but he went to work.
If he was very sick, he went to work.
Because he was very sick, he went to work.
Although he was very sick, he went to work.
questions.question:
다음 우리말을 바르게 영작한 것은?(정답 2개)
그는 많이 아팠지만, 일하러 갔다.
questions.explanation: (아팠지만(but) 출근했다 / 아팠음에도 불구하고(Although) 출근했다)

options: Because the jewel looks real, it is fake.
Although the jewel looks real, it is fake.
As though the jewel looks real, it is fake.
If the jewel looks real, it is fake.
When the jewel looks real, it is fake.
questions.question:
다음 주어진 문장과 의미가 같은 것은?
The jewel looks real, but it is fake.
questions.explanation: 'but'의 대조 의미를 나타내려면 'Although(비록~이지만)'를 사용하여 'Although the jewel looks real, it is fake.'로 표현합니다.

options: If it was cold, he stood outside all day long.
Even though it was cold, he stood outside all day long.
In spite of the cold weather, he stood outside all day long.
Though it was cold, he stood outside all day long.
It was very cold, but he stood outside all day long.
questions.question:
다음 주어진 문장과 의미가 같지 않은 것은?
Although it was cold, he stood outside all day long.
questions.explanation: 'Although it was cold'는 양보의 의미이므로, 조건의 의미를 나타내는 'If it was cold'는 의미가 다릅니다.

options: We went on a picnic though it rained.
We went on a picnic although it rained.
We went on a picnic in spite of the rain.
We went on a picnic despite the rain.
We went on a picnic during the rain.
questions.question: 다음 중 나머지 셋과 의미가 다른 것은?
questions.explanation: 1-4번은 '비가 내렸음에도 불구하고 소풍을 갔다'는 의미로 같다. 5번은 '비가 내리는 동안 소풍을 갔다'는 의미로 다르다.

options: She tried on several shoes, but she couldn't find what she liked.
She tried on several shoes even though she couldn't find what she liked.
She couldn't find what she liked although she tried on several shoes.
She tried on several shoes. Still, she couldn't find what she liked.
Although she tried on several shoes, she couldn't find what she liked.
questions.question: Which of the following doesn't have the same meaning?
questions.explanation: 2번은 문법적으로 어색하고 의미가 명확하지 않다. 나머지는 모두 '여러 신발을 시도했지만 마음에 드는 것을 찾을 수 없었다'는 같은 의미를 표현한다.

options: The baseball game was canceled since it rained.
Though it rained, the baseball game wasn't canceled.
The baseball game isn't canceled although it rained.
In spite of the rain, the baseball game wasn't canceled.
The baseball game wasn't canceled even though it rained.
questions.question: Choose one that has a DIFFERENT meaning from others.
questions.explanation: 1번은 '비가 내렸기 때문에 야구 경기가 취소되었다'는 의미이고, 나머지 2-5번은 모두 '비가 내렸음에도 불구하고 야구 경기가 취소되지 않았다'는 의미로 반대이다.

options: It rained too much to go to the music concert.
It rained a lot, but Jiwon went to the music concert.
After it rained a lot, Jiwon went to the music concert.
Jiwon was going to go to the music concert when it rained a lot.
Jiwon didn't go to the music concert because it rained a lot.
questions.question:
[지문] Although Jiwon couldn't concentrate well, she quickly did her homework. *Although it rained a lot, Jiwon still went to the music concert* after doing her homework. Although there were too many people in the concert hall, the concert was wonderful.

다음 글의 밑줄 친 부분과 의미가 가장 가까운 것은?
questions.explanation: 지문에서 'Although it rained a lot, Jiwon still went to the music concert'는 '비가 많이 내렸지만, 지원이는 여전히 음악회에 갔다'는 의미이다. 이와 같은 의미는 2번 'It rained a lot, but Jiwon went to the music concert'이다.

options: Though he is two years old, he can't read books.
Though I was only out for five minutes, I got very wet in the rain.
Though I wasn't feeling well, I went home early.
Though we were climbing up the mountain, it started to rain.
Though you agree or disagree isn't important.
questions.question: 다음 중 밑줄 친 부분의 쓰임이 자연스러운 것은?
questions.explanation: 2번은 상황과 결과의 인과관계가 자연스럽다. 1번은 어색(나이가 어려서 책을 못 읽는 것은 자연스러움), 3번은 구문상 문제, 4번은 시간적 대조, 5번은 명사절로 쓰인 though로 어색하다.

options: Although I caught a cold, I went to school.
They didn't believe him although he was telling the truth.
Although it was cold outside, they wore shorts.
Although he is very young, he acts like an old man.
He was tired although he played soccer the day before.
questions.question: 다음 중 밑줄 친 부분의 쓰임이 어색한 것은?
questions.explanation: 5번은 시간적 선후관계가 맞지 않는다. '어제 축구를 했으므로(그 결과로) 피곤했다'는 인과관계로, though/although로 대조할 수 없다.

options: _____ I was tired, I went to bed.
_____ he is lazy, he gets up late.
_____ I exercised, I gained weight.
_____ she is hungry, she had dinner.
_____ he studied, he got good grades.
questions.question: 다음 빈칸에 접속사 although가 들어갈 수 있는 것은?
questions.explanation: 3번 'Although I exercised, I gained weight(운동했음에도 불구하고 살이 찌었다)'는 대조의 의미를 명확히 나타낸다. 다른 선택지는 because/so 같은 다른 접속사가 더 자연스럽다.

options: _____ he has a good job, he doesn't complain.
_____ they had very little money, they are happy.
_____ she was tired, she tried to study hard.
_____ she caught a bad cold, she had to take the exam.
_____ Jessica is rich, she spends little money.
questions.question: 다음 빈칸에 접속사 though가 들어가기에 어색한 것은?
questions.explanation: 좋은 직업이 '있음에도' 불평하지 않는다는 문맥은 어색함. complaining이 들어가야 자연스러움

options: _____ the traffic was bad, we arrived on time.
I went home early _____ I wasn't feeling well.
_____ he is poor, he always helps people.
We hardly ever see each other _____ we live on the same street.
Brian quickly did his homework _____ he couldn't concentrate well.
questions.question: 다음 빈칸에 접속사 although가 들어가기에 어색한 것은?
questions.explanation: 몸이 좋지 않은 것은 집에 일찍 간 '원인' 이나 '이유 쪽이 자연스러움. 따라서 원인을 나타내는 접속사 because , as, since가 들어가야 올바른 문장이 됩니다.

options: _____ they are poor, they're happy.
I will do my best _____ the problem is very difficult.
_____ it was cold, they played outside.
_____ she is young, she is very brave.
_____ I got up late, I was late for school.
questions.question: 다음 중 빈칸에 들어갈 말이 나머지 셋과 다른 것은?
questions.explanation: 5번은 '늦게 일어났기 때문에(그 결과로) 학교에 지각했다'는 인과관계로, because/so가 적절하다. 나머지 1-4번은 모두 though/although가 들어가 대조의 의미를 표현한다.

options: _____ it rained, they went jogging.
I couldn't sleep _____ I was tired.
_____ the traffic was heavy, I arrived late.
_____ he didn't study much, he passed the test.
It is pretty warm _____ it is a little windy.
questions.question: 다음 중 빈칸에 들어갈 말이 나머지 셋과 다른 것은?
questions.explanation: 2번은 '피곤했음에도 불구하고 잠을 못 잤다'는 의미로, even though/although가 적절하다. 나머지는 모두 '인사에도 불구하고'의 의미로 though/although가 들어가야 한다.

options: He wore a short t-shirt _____ it was freezing.
I had a headache _____ I stayed up all night.
They put on sunglasses _____ it was really dark.
I'll buy a brand new car _____ it's so expensive.
She always passes her exams _____ she does not study at all.
questions.question: 다음 중 빈칸에 들어갈 말이 나머지 셋과 다른 것은?
questions.explanation: 3번은 '어두워서 선글라스를 썼다'는 인과관계로 because가 적절하다. 나머지는 모두 '~함에도 불구하고'의 대조 의미로 though/although가 들어가야 한다.

options: I can sleep _____ it's very noisy.
I don't like him _____ he isn't honest.
_____ it was raining, I didn't get wet.
_____ she is pretty, she isn't content with her face.
I was late for school _____ I got up early in the morning.
questions.question: 다음 중 빈칸에 들어갈 말이 나머지 셋과 다른 것은?
questions.explanation: (1, 3, 4, 5번은 비록 ~일지라도 <양보>, 2번은 정직하지 않기 때문에 <이유>

options: _____ what she cooked wasn't tasty, I ate it all.
We played soccer _____ it was raining outside.
_____ I wondered what made him nervous, I didn't ask him.
He didn't go to the meeting _____ he was sick.
The car was expensive _____ it was old and worn.
questions.question: 다음 중 빈칸에 들어갈 말이 나머지 셋과 다른 것은?
questions.explanation: 4번은 '아파서 회의에 가지 않았다'는 인과관계로 because가 적절하다. 나머지는 모두 '~함에도 불구하고'의 대조 의미로 though/although가 들어가야 한다.

options: _____ summer is a fun season, I can't stand the heat!
_____ tomatoes are low in calories, they make you feel full.
_____ it explains everything very clearly, it is a really useful book.
_____ he was in poor health, he continued to carry out her duties.
_____ the house was destroyed, no one was hurt.
questions.question: Choose the sentence that has the different word in the blank from others.
questions.explanation: (1, 2, 4, 5번은 비록 ~일지라도 <양보>, 3번은 명쾌하게 설명해 주기 때문에 <이유>

options: _____ the field trip to the museum was short, I really enjoyed it.
I practiced playing the piano _____ I felt tired.
She could see with her heart _____ she was blind.
I couldn't phone you _____ I hadn't got your phone number.
There's a chance she'll recover _____ the doctors can't say for certain.
questions.question: Choose the sentence that has the different word from the others in each blank.
questions.explanation: 4번은 '전화 번호가 없었기 때문에 전화할 수 없었다'는 인과관계로 because가 적절하다. 나머지는 모두 '~함에도 불구하고'의 대조 의미로 though/although가 들어가야 한다.

options: _____ he studied a lot, he didn't pass the exam.
_____ it is hot today, ice cream is melting very fast.
I don't want your help _____ I'm in need.
_____ he didn't learn the advanced math, he can solve the problems such as algebra, calculus.
We went on a picnic _____ it rained.
questions.question: Choose the sentence that has the different word from the others in each blank.
questions.explanation: 1, 3, 4, 5번은 비록 ~일지라도 <양보>, 2번은 오늘 더워서 아이스크림이 녹는다 <이유>

options: He is not very active although he's nearly 80.
Though I took a wrong bus, I was late for the meeting.
Even though the sun was shining, it was very warm.
Despite my illness, I couldn't be absent from school.
I like my brother though he sometimes makes me angry.
questions.question: 다음 중 흐름상 가장 자연스러운 문장은?
questions.explanation: 나를 화나게 할 때가 있지만 내 남동생이 좋다 <흐름 자연스러움>

options: She couldn't get good grades although she studied very hard.
Although he studied hard, he got a good grade on the test.
She could see with her heart although she was blind.
Although Kevin's aunt lives in China, she doesn't speak Chinese.
Although Coke is not good for our health, the doctor advised me to drink it every day.
questions.question: 다음 중 흐름상 어색한 문장은?
questions.explanation: 5번은 '콜라가 건강에 좋지 않음에도 불구하고 의사가 매일 마시라고 조언했다'는 의미로 상식과 맞지 않아 어색하다. 나머지는 모두 자연스럽다.

options: We went on a picnic though it was rainy.
She failed the test even though she had studied hard.
He is strong and healthy though he is seventy years old.
She couldn't eat the meal though she was very hungry.
He didn't go to school even though he was sick.
questions.question: 다음 중 흐름상 어색한 문장은?
questions.explanation: 5번은 '아팠음에도 불구하고 학교에 가지 않았다'는 의미로 어색하다. 정상적으로는 '아파서 학교에 가지 않았다(because)'이다. 나머지는 모두 대조 관계가 명확하고 자연스럽다.

options: Despite he lost his job, he still wastes his money.
Despite the pearl looks real, it is fake.
Although rained a lot, Jessica went camping.
Although the heavy rain, they played outside.
He is quite strong although he is very old.
questions.question: 다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장은?
questions.explanation: 5번이 문법적으로 올바르다. 1번은 'Despite'는 전치사로 명사만 올 수 있다. 2번은 'looks'가 있으면 부사절이라 Although를 써야 한다. 3번은 주어가 없다. 4번은 'rain'이 동사인데 명사형이 필요하다.

options: Despite it rained heavily, we played soccer.
Though it rained heavily, we played soccer.
In spite of the heavy rain, we played soccer.
Although it rained heavily, we played soccer.
Even though it rained heavily, we played soccer.
questions.question: 다음 중 어법상 어색한 문장은?
questions.explanation: 1번은 'Despite'는 전치사로 절(it rained heavily)을 취할 수 없다. 전치사는 명사구만 취한다. 나머지 2-5번은 모두 문법적으로 올바르다.

options: In spite of he has no money, he is still happy.
Although his diligence, he failed the test.
Although she studied hard, she gets straight Ds.
Even though worked hard, Tom couldn't finish his report.
She couldn't get them even though she read the instructions twice.
questions.question: 다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장은?
questions.explanation: 5번이 문법적으로 올바르다. 1번은 'In spite of'는 전치사로 절을 취할 수 없다. 2번은 'Although'는 접속사로 완전한 절이 필요하다. 3번은 시제가 일치하지 않는다. 4번은 'worked' 앞에 주어가 없다.

options: As if
Because
Unless
Although
Since
questions.question:
다음 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?
__________ everyone played well, we lost the game.
questions.explanation: 우리가 경기에 졌다는 사실과 모두가 잘 했다는 내용이 대조되므로 양보의 의미 'Although(비록~이지만)'가 적절합니다.

options: As if
Because
Although
When
Since
questions.question:
다음 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?
__________ the wind was blowing, it wasn't very cold.
questions.explanation: 바람이 불고 있다는 사실과 추위가 심하지 않다는 내용이 대조되므로 양보의 의미 'Although(비록~이지만)'가 적절합니다.

options: Even
Although
Before
With
But
questions.question:
다음 두 문장의 의미가 같도록 빈 곳에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?
We can't be together, but I always love you.
= __________ we can't be together, I always love you.
questions.explanation: 'but'의 의미(대조)를 나타내려면 양보절 'Although(비록~이지만)'로 표현해야 합니다.

options: despite
unless
since
because
although
questions.question:
다음 대화의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?
A: Did you go to bed early last night?
B: I stayed up late __________ I was very exhausted.
questions.explanation: 늦게 깨어 있었다는 것과 피곤했다는 내용이 인과관계이므로 'because(왜냐하면)'가 적절합니다.

options: because
unless
although
that
since
questions.question:
다음 대화의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?
A: What did Rachel do last weekend?
B: She went hiking __________ it was snowy and chilly.
questions.explanation: 눈이 오고 쌀쌀함에도 불구하고 하이킹을 갔다는 대조 관계이므로 'although(비록~이지만)'가 적절합니다.

options: he couldn't have breakfast
he didn't do his homework
he didn't take his lunchbox
he wasn't late for the class
he missed the bus
questions.question:
다음 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?
Though he got up late, __________.
questions.explanation: 'Though he got up late(늦게 일어났음에도 불구하고)'라는 양보절에 대조되는 결과는 '수업에 늦지 않았다'가 적절합니다.

options: we arrived on time
I got there on time
we didn't miss the class
we weren't late for school
I was too late to be on time
questions.question:
다음 대화의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 적절하지 않은 것은?
A: Was the traffic heavy?
B: Yes, it was. Although the traffic was heavy, __________.
questions.explanation: 교통이 막혔음에도 불구하고라는 양보 관계에 '너무 늦어서 제 시간에 도착하지 못했다'는 모순되므로 적절하지 않습니다.

options: I didn't pass the exam
they had no trouble getting there
I failed the exam
I passed the exam
they couldn't arrive on time
questions.question:
다음 문장이 자연스러운 의미가 되도록 빈 칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은? (정답 2개)
• Though the students didn't have a map, __________.
• Though I made a mistake, __________.
questions.explanation: (지도가 없었지만 잘 찾아갔다 / 실수를 했지만 시험에 합격했다)

options: (A) while / (B) For
(A) while / (B) Although
(A) although / (B) To
(A) although / (B) In spite of
(A) although / (B) For
questions.question:
다음 글의 빈칸 (A), (B)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?
• He refused to attend the seminar (A)__________ they asked him to do many times.
• (B)__________ being late for school, she could take the exam.
questions.explanation: (A)는 '많이 요청했음에도 불구하고'라는 양보 의미의 'although'가 적절하고, (B)는 '수업에 늦은 것에도 불구하고'라는 양보 의미의 'In spite of'가 적절합니다.

options: (A) so / (B) Although
(A) since / (B) Before
(A) because / (B) Though
(A) that / (B) As
(A) whether / (B) If
questions.question:
다음 글의 빈칸 (A), (B)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?
• They were very happy (A)__________ they won the game.
• (B)__________ the sun was shining, it wasn't very warm.
questions.explanation: (A)는 '경기를 이겼기 때문에 행복했다'는 인과 관계의 'because'가 적절하고, (B)는 '태양이 비치고 있음에도 불구하고 따뜻하지 않다'는 양보 의미의 'Though'가 적절합니다.

options: (A) despite / (B) While
(A) although / (B) But
(A) although / (B) Though
(A) although / (B) in spite of
(A) despite / (B) Though
questions.question:
다음 빈칸 (A), (B)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?
• Her voice was shaking (A)__________ all her efforts to control it.
• (B)__________ Betty left me 20 years ago, I still miss her.
questions.explanation: (A는 이겼기 때문에 <이유>, B는 해가 빛났지만 따뜻하지 않았다 <양보>)

options: (A) Since / (B) While / (C) As
(A) Although / (B) But / (C) Because
(A) Though / (B) Though / (C) Although
(A) As / (B) But / (C) But
(A) Since / (B) Though / (C) Even though
questions.question:
다음 글의 빈칸 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?
• (A)__________ the weather is so bad, I'm not going out today.
• (B)__________ Betty left me 20 years ago, I still miss her.
• (C)__________ it was raining, we continued playing soccer.
questions.explanation: A는 날씨가 나쁘기 때문에 <이유: Since>, B와 C는 반대 내용 <양보: Though / Even though>

options: once
since
although
because
however
questions.question:
다음 문장의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 적절하지 않은 것은? (대소문자 관계없음)
• I got up late __________ I had a bad cold.
• __________ I was late, I went to the meeting.
• I have studied English __________ I was five years old.
• __________ the food gets into the rivers, the water quickly becomes dirty.
• I don't like hamburgers __________ they're bad for my health.
questions.explanation: 'however'는 부사이며 다른 보기들은 접속사이므로, 문맥에 맞는 접속사만 가능합니다. 특히 마지막 문장에서 'they're bad for my health'라는 이유를 나타내므로 'because'가 필요하고, 'however'는 문법적으로 맞지 않습니다.

options: (A) Although / (B) although
(A) As long as / (B) although
(A) Because / (B) as long as
(A) Although / (B) because
(A) So / (B) as long as
questions.question:
다음 글의 빈칸 (A), (B)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?
• At first, you thought that it would be very warm because the sun was shining, but when you later went outside, it wasn't very warm.
→ (A)__________ the sun was shining, it wasn't very warm.
• What he felt towards her was love. He never called it 'love,' but that didn't change the fact that he loved her.
→ He was in love with her (B)__________ he did not put that name to his feeling.
questions.explanation: (A)는 '태양이 비치고 있음에도 불구하고 따뜻하지 않다'는 대조의 'Although'가 적절하고, (B)는 '그 감정에 이름을 붙이지 않았음에도 불구하고 사랑했다'는 대조의 'although'가 적절합니다.

options: Because the weather was bad, many people came to see the concert.
Though the weather was bad, many people came to see the concert.
While the weather was bad, many people came to see the concert.
Thanks to the bad weather, many people came to see the concert.
Due to the bad weather, many people came to see the concert.
questions.question:
다음 우리말을 바르게 영작한 것은?
날씨는 나빴지만, 많은 사람들이 콘서트를 보기 위해 왔다.
questions.explanation: '날씨는 나빴지만'은 양보의 의미이므로 'Though(비록~이지만)'가 가장 적절합니다.

options: Since I didn't win the contest, I was proud of myself.
I didn't win the contest since I was proud of myself.
Though I didn't win the contest, I was proud of myself.
I didn't win the contest although I was proud of myself.
Until I didn't win the contest, I was proud of myself.
questions.question:
다음 우리말을 바르게 영작한 것은?
비록 대회에서 이기지 못했지만, 나는 내가 자랑스럽다.
questions.explanation: '비록~이지만'은 양보의 의미이므로 'Though'를 사용하여 'Though I didn't win the contest, I was proud of myself.'가 정답입니다.

options: Since she felt like crying, she was smiling.
She felt like crying, but she was smiling.
Even though she felt like crying, she was smiling.
Because she felt like crying, she was smiling.
She felt like crying although she was smiling.
questions.question:
다음 우리말을 바르게 영작한 것은?(정답 2개)
울고 싶지만, 그녀는 미소를 짓고 있었다.
questions.explanation: 울고 싶었지만(but) 미소 지었다 / 울고 싶었음에도 불구하고(Even though) 미소 지었다

options: He was very sick, so he went to work.
He was very sick, but he went to work.
If he was very sick, he went to work.
Because he was very sick, he went to work.
Although he was very sick, he went to work.
questions.question:
다음 우리말을 바르게 영작한 것은?(정답 2개)
그는 많이 아팠지만, 일하러 갔다.
questions.explanation: (아팠지만(but) 출근했다 / 아팠음에도 불구하고(Although) 출근했다)

options: Because the jewel looks real, it is fake.
Although the jewel looks real, it is fake.
As though the jewel looks real, it is fake.
If the jewel looks real, it is fake.
When the jewel looks real, it is fake.
questions.question:
다음 주어진 문장과 의미가 같은 것은?
The jewel looks real, but it is fake.
questions.explanation: 'but'의 대조 의미를 나타내려면 'Although(비록~이지만)'를 사용하여 'Although the jewel looks real, it is fake.'로 표현합니다.

options: If it was cold, he stood outside all day long.
Even though it was cold, he stood outside all day long.
In spite of the cold weather, he stood outside all day long.
Though it was cold, he stood outside all day long.
It was very cold, but he stood outside all day long.
questions.question:
다음 주어진 문장과 의미가 같지 않은 것은?
Although it was cold, he stood outside all day long.
questions.explanation: 'Although it was cold'는 양보의 의미이므로, 조건의 의미를 나타내는 'If it was cold'는 의미가 다릅니다.

options: We went on a picnic though it rained.
We went on a picnic although it rained.
We went on a picnic in spite of the rain.
We went on a picnic despite the rain.
We went on a picnic during the rain.
questions.question: 다음 중 나머지 셋과 의미가 다른 것은?
questions.explanation: 1-4번은 '비가 내렸음에도 불구하고 소풍을 갔다'는 의미로 같다. 5번은 '비가 내리는 동안 소풍을 갔다'는 의미로 다르다.

options: She tried on several shoes, but she couldn't find what she liked.
She tried on several shoes even though she couldn't find what she liked.
She couldn't find what she liked although she tried on several shoes.
She tried on several shoes. Still, she couldn't find what she liked.
Although she tried on several shoes, she couldn't find what she liked.
questions.question: Which of the following doesn't have the same meaning?
questions.explanation: 2번은 문법적으로 어색하고 의미가 명확하지 않다. 나머지는 모두 '여러 신발을 시도했지만 마음에 드는 것을 찾을 수 없었다'는 같은 의미를 표현한다.

options: The baseball game was canceled since it rained.
Though it rained, the baseball game wasn't canceled.
The baseball game isn't canceled although it rained.
In spite of the rain, the baseball game wasn't canceled.
The baseball game wasn't canceled even though it rained.
questions.question: Choose one that has a DIFFERENT meaning from others.
questions.explanation: 1번은 '비가 내렸기 때문에 야구 경기가 취소되었다'는 의미이고, 나머지 2-5번은 모두 '비가 내렸음에도 불구하고 야구 경기가 취소되지 않았다'는 의미로 반대이다.

options: It rained too much to go to the music concert.
It rained a lot, but Jiwon went to the music concert.
After it rained a lot, Jiwon went to the music concert.
Jiwon was going to go to the music concert when it rained a lot.
Jiwon didn't go to the music concert because it rained a lot.
questions.question:
[지문] Although Jiwon couldn't concentrate well, she quickly did her homework. *Although it rained a lot, Jiwon still went to the music concert* after doing her homework. Although there were too many people in the concert hall, the concert was wonderful.

다음 글의 밑줄 친 부분과 의미가 가장 가까운 것은?
questions.explanation: 지문에서 'Although it rained a lot, Jiwon still went to the music concert'는 '비가 많이 내렸지만, 지원이는 여전히 음악회에 갔다'는 의미이다. 이와 같은 의미는 2번 'It rained a lot, but Jiwon went to the music concert'이다.

options: Though he is two years old, he can't read books.
Though I was only out for five minutes, I got very wet in the rain.
Though I wasn't feeling well, I went home early.
Though we were climbing up the mountain, it started to rain.
Though you agree or disagree isn't important.
questions.question: 다음 중 밑줄 친 부분의 쓰임이 자연스러운 것은?
questions.explanation: 2번은 상황과 결과의 인과관계가 자연스럽다. 1번은 어색(나이가 어려서 책을 못 읽는 것은 자연스러움), 3번은 구문상 문제, 4번은 시간적 대조, 5번은 명사절로 쓰인 though로 어색하다.

options: Although I caught a cold, I went to school.
They didn't believe him although he was telling the truth.
Although it was cold outside, they wore shorts.
Although he is very young, he acts like an old man.
He was tired although he played soccer the day before.
questions.question: 다음 중 밑줄 친 부분의 쓰임이 어색한 것은?
questions.explanation: 5번은 시간적 선후관계가 맞지 않는다. '어제 축구를 했으므로(그 결과로) 피곤했다'는 인과관계로, though/although로 대조할 수 없다.

options: _____ I was tired, I went to bed.
_____ he is lazy, he gets up late.
_____ I exercised, I gained weight.
_____ she is hungry, she had dinner.
_____ he studied, he got good grades.
questions.question: 다음 빈칸에 접속사 although가 들어갈 수 있는 것은?
questions.explanation: 3번 'Although I exercised, I gained weight(운동했음에도 불구하고 살이 찌었다)'는 대조의 의미를 명확히 나타낸다. 다른 선택지는 because/so 같은 다른 접속사가 더 자연스럽다.

options: _____ he has a good job, he doesn't complain.
_____ they had very little money, they are happy.
_____ she was tired, she tried to study hard.
_____ she caught a bad cold, she had to take the exam.
_____ Jessica is rich, she spends little money.
questions.question: 다음 빈칸에 접속사 though가 들어가기에 어색한 것은?
questions.explanation: 좋은 직업이 '있음에도' 불평하지 않는다는 문맥은 어색함. complaining이 들어가야 자연스러움

options: _____ the traffic was bad, we arrived on time.
I went home early _____ I wasn't feeling well.
_____ he is poor, he always helps people.
We hardly ever see each other _____ we live on the same street.
Brian quickly did his homework _____ he couldn't concentrate well.
questions.question: 다음 빈칸에 접속사 although가 들어가기에 어색한 것은?
questions.explanation: 몸이 좋지 않은 것은 집에 일찍 간 '원인' 이나 '이유 쪽이 자연스러움. 따라서 원인을 나타내는 접속사 because , as, since가 들어가야 올바른 문장이 됩니다.

options: _____ they are poor, they're happy.
I will do my best _____ the problem is very difficult.
_____ it was cold, they played outside.
_____ she is young, she is very brave.
_____ I got up late, I was late for school.
questions.question: 다음 중 빈칸에 들어갈 말이 나머지 셋과 다른 것은?
questions.explanation: 5번은 '늦게 일어났기 때문에(그 결과로) 학교에 지각했다'는 인과관계로, because/so가 적절하다. 나머지 1-4번은 모두 though/although가 들어가 대조의 의미를 표현한다.

options: _____ it rained, they went jogging.
I couldn't sleep _____ I was tired.
_____ the traffic was heavy, I arrived late.
_____ he didn't study much, he passed the test.
It is pretty warm _____ it is a little windy.
questions.question: 다음 중 빈칸에 들어갈 말이 나머지 셋과 다른 것은?
questions.explanation: 2번은 '피곤했음에도 불구하고 잠을 못 잤다'는 의미로, even though/although가 적절하다. 나머지는 모두 '인사에도 불구하고'의 의미로 though/although가 들어가야 한다.

options: He wore a short t-shirt _____ it was freezing.
I had a headache _____ I stayed up all night.
They put on sunglasses _____ it was really dark.
I'll buy a brand new car _____ it's so expensive.
She always passes her exams _____ she does not study at all.
questions.question: 다음 중 빈칸에 들어갈 말이 나머지 셋과 다른 것은?
questions.explanation: 3번은 '어두워서 선글라스를 썼다'는 인과관계로 because가 적절하다. 나머지는 모두 '~함에도 불구하고'의 대조 의미로 though/although가 들어가야 한다.

options: I can sleep _____ it's very noisy.
I don't like him _____ he isn't honest.
_____ it was raining, I didn't get wet.
_____ she is pretty, she isn't content with her face.
I was late for school _____ I got up early in the morning.
questions.question: 다음 중 빈칸에 들어갈 말이 나머지 셋과 다른 것은?
questions.explanation: (1, 3, 4, 5번은 비록 ~일지라도 <양보>, 2번은 정직하지 않기 때문에 <이유>

options: _____ what she cooked wasn't tasty, I ate it all.
We played soccer _____ it was raining outside.
_____ I wondered what made him nervous, I didn't ask him.
He didn't go to the meeting _____ he was sick.
The car was expensive _____ it was old and worn.
questions.question: 다음 중 빈칸에 들어갈 말이 나머지 셋과 다른 것은?
questions.explanation: 4번은 '아파서 회의에 가지 않았다'는 인과관계로 because가 적절하다. 나머지는 모두 '~함에도 불구하고'의 대조 의미로 though/although가 들어가야 한다.

options: _____ summer is a fun season, I can't stand the heat!
_____ tomatoes are low in calories, they make you feel full.
_____ it explains everything very clearly, it is a really useful book.
_____ he was in poor health, he continued to carry out her duties.
_____ the house was destroyed, no one was hurt.
questions.question: Choose the sentence that has the different word in the blank from others.
questions.explanation: (1, 2, 4, 5번은 비록 ~일지라도 <양보>, 3번은 명쾌하게 설명해 주기 때문에 <이유>

options: _____ the field trip to the museum was short, I really enjoyed it.
I practiced playing the piano _____ I felt tired.
She could see with her heart _____ she was blind.
I couldn't phone you _____ I hadn't got your phone number.
There's a chance she'll recover _____ the doctors can't say for certain.
questions.question: Choose the sentence that has the different word from the others in each blank.
questions.explanation: 4번은 '전화 번호가 없었기 때문에 전화할 수 없었다'는 인과관계로 because가 적절하다. 나머지는 모두 '~함에도 불구하고'의 대조 의미로 though/although가 들어가야 한다.

options: _____ he studied a lot, he didn't pass the exam.
_____ it is hot today, ice cream is melting very fast.
I don't want your help _____ I'm in need.
_____ he didn't learn the advanced math, he can solve the problems such as algebra, calculus.
We went on a picnic _____ it rained.
questions.question: Choose the sentence that has the different word from the others in each blank.
questions.explanation: 1, 3, 4, 5번은 비록 ~일지라도 <양보>, 2번은 오늘 더워서 아이스크림이 녹는다 <이유>

options: He is not very active although he's nearly 80.
Though I took a wrong bus, I was late for the meeting.
Even though the sun was shining, it was very warm.
Despite my illness, I couldn't be absent from school.
I like my brother though he sometimes makes me angry.
questions.question: 다음 중 흐름상 가장 자연스러운 문장은?
questions.explanation: 나를 화나게 할 때가 있지만 내 남동생이 좋다 <흐름 자연스러움>

options: She couldn't get good grades although she studied very hard.
Although he studied hard, he got a good grade on the test.
She could see with her heart although she was blind.
Although Kevin's aunt lives in China, she doesn't speak Chinese.
Although Coke is not good for our health, the doctor advised me to drink it every day.
questions.question: 다음 중 흐름상 어색한 문장은?
questions.explanation: 5번은 '콜라가 건강에 좋지 않음에도 불구하고 의사가 매일 마시라고 조언했다'는 의미로 상식과 맞지 않아 어색하다. 나머지는 모두 자연스럽다.

options: We went on a picnic though it was rainy.
She failed the test even though she had studied hard.
He is strong and healthy though he is seventy years old.
She couldn't eat the meal though she was very hungry.
He didn't go to school even though he was sick.
questions.question: 다음 중 흐름상 어색한 문장은?
questions.explanation: 5번은 '아팠음에도 불구하고 학교에 가지 않았다'는 의미로 어색하다. 정상적으로는 '아파서 학교에 가지 않았다(because)'이다. 나머지는 모두 대조 관계가 명확하고 자연스럽다.

options: Despite he lost his job, he still wastes his money.
Despite the pearl looks real, it is fake.
Although rained a lot, Jessica went camping.
Although the heavy rain, they played outside.
He is quite strong although he is very old.
questions.question: 다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장은?
questions.explanation: 5번이 문법적으로 올바르다. 1번은 'Despite'는 전치사로 명사만 올 수 있다. 2번은 'looks'가 있으면 부사절이라 Although를 써야 한다. 3번은 주어가 없다. 4번은 'rain'이 동사인데 명사형이 필요하다.

options: Despite it rained heavily, we played soccer.
Though it rained heavily, we played soccer.
In spite of the heavy rain, we played soccer.
Although it rained heavily, we played soccer.
Even though it rained heavily, we played soccer.
questions.question: 다음 중 어법상 어색한 문장은?
questions.explanation: 1번은 'Despite'는 전치사로 절(it rained heavily)을 취할 수 없다. 전치사는 명사구만 취한다. 나머지 2-5번은 모두 문법적으로 올바르다.

options: In spite of he has no money, he is still happy.
Although his diligence, he failed the test.
Although she studied hard, she gets straight Ds.
Even though worked hard, Tom couldn't finish his report.
She couldn't get them even though she read the instructions twice.
questions.question: 다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장은?
questions.explanation: 5번이 문법적으로 올바르다. 1번은 'In spite of'는 전치사로 절을 취할 수 없다. 2번은 'Although'는 접속사로 완전한 절이 필요하다. 3번은 시제가 일치하지 않는다. 4번은 'worked' 앞에 주어가 없다.
